blocking_findings.evidence: execution/fetch_ir_documents.py process_ticker records exc.committed counts but never adds the URL to `already`. On the next run the DB row's source_url places the URL in `already`, so only the skip path runs. That path calls src/pipeline/managed_ir_sources.py replay_registered_issuer_document_publications -> _replay_registered_result. _replay_registered_result first reads data/managed_ir_publications/<attempt>/publication_result.json. When _finalize_committed raised publication_committed_partial before the result was written (inventory_state failed or result_state not_started), that file does not exist. read_stable_artifact then raises OSError, which becomes 'registered_publication_result_invalid', and the run reports projection_failed/failed. Every later run repeats this, so the publication stays permanently failed. publish_prepared_issuer_documents can finalize from the durable managed_ir_publications row plus the retained attempt staging receipt, but no caller reaches it once the URL is registered.
